justification: The only real overlap is very generic: both include schematized animate forms or body-like parts, but A is dominated by multiple profile animals, signs, and patterned bands, while B depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with head, torso, arms, and facial features. There is no shared iconographic scheme, relationship among elements, or comparable surface arrangement: A is a crowded register-like composition of animals and symbols, whereas B is a monumental solitary body.
